about: SCION 42 trace, measured from the render. x_screen/y_screen: centroid of the dog's rendered alpha (px, static camera, 1 m = 190 px, threshold x=0 at screen x 310). facing: +1 toward the door (left); measured from the head layer's screen position against the centroid for the learned puppet, from the kit nose keypoint for archive views (0 = facing the camera). visibility: profile-L/-R = learned puppet, view = whole archive frame, turn-learned = puppet carried into its learned fit of an archive turning frame, turn-blend = that fit dissolving with the real frame, head-swing = head and neck layers swinging round their learned hinge. override: share of the pose that is a hand-set rotation about learned hinges (lying, chin down, look in, head carried low beyond the examples). state switches at the onsets measured on screen (summary.onsets_measured).

onsets_measured.measure: dog centroid moves right (away from the door) > 1 px from its 0.9 s position
head rises: head top > 2 px above its lowest point of the retreat (1.4-2.2 s)
the turn away begins: first frame the puppet leaves its profile pose for the learned turning pose
the head starts to swing up and round (head-and-neck layers leave their resting pose)
centroid moves toward the door > 1 px, or the head drops > 2 px, from 14.5 s
the body goes down: centroid > 2 px lower than at 23.6 s
the head leaves its resting place: head centre moves > 2 px from its 26.2 s position (it lifts and turns into the room)

feet_vs_travel_approach.note: a planted foot moves < 0.35 x the body per frame; 1.0 would be a foot that slides with the body
